name: Encore City: art bible v2
supersedes: docs/island3d/art-bible.json (kept for history; every v1 token stays defined unchanged)
vibe: A designer-toy diorama of a tiny harbour city, not a nursery toy: crisp bevelled concrete, smoked glass, teak boardwalks, gunmetal rails, LED strips and screens. Golden hour is the default; Showtime is full night with an indigo sky, a magenta city glow, three sweeping cones, LED edges and the crew on stage. The cuteness dial moves from baby to cool older sibling: smaller confident eyes, longer legs, less squash, witty copy.

colourRule.perObject: Up to 3 tones of one family plus up to 1 neon accent.
colourRule.buildings: 1 neutral body + 1 accent + Smoked Glass + neon/LED: at most 4 materials and 4 meshes.
colourRule.neonUse: Neon goes only on lines, rings, signs and screens, never a surface.

kept.note: Star Gold (points, focus ring, selection hull) and Success (BUY, valid cell) keep their v1 values. LOCKED colours are byte-identical; walls and doors only gain new keys.

neonSets.rule: Every LED colour set mixes at least 4 hues (including the member colour) and no hue covers more than 35%.

presets.sunNote: The sun and the moon share ONE fixed direction, so the static shadow map never re-renders for light changes.
presets.DAY: The v1 pastel DAY preset stays exported but unused by the island.
presets.calibration: At golden hour lit Turf reads #4FA36A ±6% L. Tune only the key intensity.

cityWakesUp.rule: Lights fade in; never a pop.

ambientDrift.note: Colours and intensities move; the direction never does. P1.

STUDIO.clear: transparent over the dark CSS well

flashSafety.skylineWindows: At most one switch per ramp, with a 1.2 s fade.
flashSafety.fullScreen: No full-screen luminance change over 20% within 0.5 s, no strobe, no full-screen white.

materials.windows: Lit windows swap to Window Warm through the shared state material.
materials.ledScreens: MeshBasic plus the shared atlas, animated by UV offset only and never redrawn per frame; they share the emoji-face basic+map program.
materials.surfaces: Concrete and paving get ±3% L vertex noise on a 0.25 u grid; teak alternates Teak / Teak Light per plank. At most 3 overlapping transparents.

signWords.plus: the child's own first name and initial
signWords.never: brands, logos, Hangul, K-pop or idol wording
signWords.screens: EQ bars, waves, ✦ sparks, member gradients, a star field and the child's emoji

characters.petcol: LOCKED; shape, eyes and motion change only.

species.dragon: horns cone(0.02, 0.095) swept 40°, 5 spines, 3 wing ribs; sparkles only, never fire

motion.danceBreak: an 8-count at 118 BPM of generic moves only

accessoriesRestyled.acc_shades: one wraparound Midnight Ink shield lens, FOIL at night

avatar.face: the child's emoji on the face cap, never a realistic face
avatar.idle: weight shift 2.4 s, glance every 6 s
avatar.showtime: Spark Stick twirl 360° over 1.2 s every 8 s (off under reduced motion)

sparkStick.head: 4-point ✦ prism rOut 0.06 rIn 0.016 depth 0.022
sparkStick.never: never 5-pointed; never a sphere, heart, hammer, cube, crown, bird, hexagon or ring head

crowd.hero: 2 Bone White eye dots; no mouths, no faces

ui.scope: Island and games only; learning screens keep their fonts.

theme.panel: rgba(22,18,40,.72) blur(16px) saturate(1.3); solid #15112A on LOW

ui.icons: In-house inline-SVG line set (24 grid, 2px round stroke, currentColor); emoji only for the avatar and ⭐.
ui.contrast: At least 4.5:1; #FF2E9A and #22E4FF as text only at 18px bold or larger on dark.

copy.voice: A cool older cousin who runs the stage crew: short, confident, a little witty, never babyish or sarcastic.
rules: UK English, sentence case, verbs first
At most one emoji, only when it carries meaning
'Pets' becomes 'Crew' in labels only; ids unchanged
Celebrate effort and saving, never luck
Keep every reassurance: pets never get sad, game scores never earn or spend ⭐
copy.table: world/world-copy.js (SLWorldCopy.t / desc); CATALOG names and descriptions are never edited.

dontDo: Don't copy or evoke real idols, groups, agencies, songs, music shows, venues, logos, fandom names or fandom colour schemes. No Hangul and no 'K-pop' or 'idol' wording in the UI.
Don't use any real light-stick silhouette. The 4-point ✦ Spark Stick is the only light stick and must never read as the 5-point ⭐ reward.
Don't use recognisable choreography: generic moves only (groove bounce, step-touch, point, spin, hop-turn, freeze).
Don't flash faster than 2 Hz; full-contrast LED chases ≤ 1.5 Hz; beat pulses ≤ ±35%; no strobe, no full-screen flash.
Don't go edgy or teen-adult: no skulls, flames, weapons, graffiti words, nightclubs, bars or alcohol (the café serves boba).
Don't make it dark or scary: the darkest value is Night Zenith #0B0A1F and the island reads on LOW at both presets.
Don't paint neon onto big surfaces.
Don't edit existing CATALOG ids, prices, names, descriptions, LOCKED colours, ECONOMY, REGIONS, canPlace or GAME_RULES.
Don't introduce chance: no random variants at purchase, no loot boxes, timers or 'limited time'.
Don't jitter houses, buildings, attractions or paths; only organic decor (and small decor's fixed -20/0/+20° yaw).
Don't make the backdrop pickable or look like buildable land.
Don't use transparent glass, PointLights, SpotLights, real-time shadow updates or new post-processing; stay within 12 programs and 70/100/150 draw calls.
Don't put words in textures outside the SIGN_WORDS whitelist plus the child's own name or initial.
Don't download models, textures, HDRIs, sounds or fonts beyond Unbounded and Outfit.
Don't lose the cartoon safety net: pets never get sad, no injuries, the dragon never breathes fire.
Don't over-bounce: no overshoot on UI sheets, no jelly squash on buildings.
Don't write babyish copy, and don't put more than one emoji in a message.
